name: TCV Chestnut Fund
summary: Small grants of last resort for grassroots community groups in the TCV Community Network doing practical conservation volunteering; start-up grants cover running costs and support grants cover tools, equipment and training.

amount.note: Support grant for tools, equipment and training

steps: Apply through the Community Network Portal

eligibility.rule: Is a TCV Community Network member before applying
Has little or no money for tools, equipment and training

applicant_types.quote: The TCV Chestnut Fund grant scheme has been designed to support grassroots community groups and initiatives wanting to deliver practical volunteering that improves the natural physical environment

access.quote: If you are already a Community Network Member you can apply through the Community Network Portal.

amount.quote: Support grants These are for groups who have little or no money for tools, equipment and training. This grant is available to all groups, regardless of how long they have been constituted. The maximum grant will be £500.

effort.quote: Please join the TCV Community Network to be eligible to apply for the Chestnut Fund Grant scheme.
If you are already a Community Network Member you can apply through the Community Network Portal.

eligibility.quote: Groups must be members of the TCV Community Network prior to applying for a TCV Chestnut Fund grant.
These are for groups who have little or no money for tools, equipment and training.
